title: 1 Peter Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 1 Peter 2: living stones, a chosen race, and following the steps of Christ.

questions.text: What should they long for as newborn babies?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow.

answers.text: The pure milk of the Word

questions.text: According to verse 4, how is the living stone treated by men and by God?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 speaks of coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

answers.text: Honored by men and by God
Hidden from men and from God
Rejected by men, but chosen by God
Sought by men, refused by God

questions.text: What are they said in verse 5 to be built up as?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: you also, as living stones, are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood.

questions.text: Which of these does verse 9 call them?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 calls them a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's own possession.

questions.text: Who is named as supreme in verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says to subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake, whether to the king, as supreme.

questions.text: Whom are they told to fear in verse 17?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says: honor all men, love the brotherhood, fear God, honor the king.

questions.text: To which masters are servants told in verse 18 to be in subjection?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says servants should be in subjection to their masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

answers.text: Only to those who pay well
To the wicked ones as well

questions.text: What did Christ leave them, according to verse 21?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 says that Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps.

questions.text: What does verse 24 say he bore in his body on the tree?
questions.explanation: Verse 24 says he himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we might live to righteousness.

questions.text: To whom have they now returned, after going astray like sheep?
questions.explanation: Verse 25 says: for you were going astray like sheep, but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
